prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: AI Village bookhouse interior production concept candidate, one unlabelled 3:4 portrait illustration, 1080x1440 composition.
Primary request: an inviting small reading room for a quiet illustrated village game. Warm cream plaster walls, honey oak joinery, sage green cushions, soft painterly foliage visible beyond a left arched window, soft late afternoon daylight. Gentle gouache-like painted detail, no heavy outlines, calm storybook atmosphere matching a sunlit cream-stone village courtyard.
Composition/framing: fixed slightly elevated frontal dollhouse camera, never isometric. Match a 360x480 logical layout: rear wall ends at y=220 (46% height). Arched window centered x=102,y=130; low window bench x44..160,y198..240. One compact three-tier bookcase x234..320,y126..240. One single reading desk x72..212,y292..359, chair centered x142 behind it. These are the ONLY freestanding furniture. Keep wide clear wooden walking floor around them, especially x36..324,y360..440; unoccupied entry space near x180,y420. Furniture should look small enough for chibi residents to be added later. Desk with one closed sage book and small blank cream paper; bookcase books have no readable titles. A small pendant lamp high in center, gentle beams above.
Lighting/mood: luminous diffuse warm daylight from left, restrained shadows, no bloom. Natural cream paper, honey wood, sage, muted rust and dusty lavender book spines.
Constraints: no characters, animals, people, text, typography, UI, labels, arrows, bounding boxes, watermark, logos, rugs, extra tables, stairs, floor clutter or foreground foliage hiding the walking space. Preserve room readability at small size. This is a flat composition candidate; do not imply it is a layered or runtime-ready asset.
